overview: The period is dominated by agentic and LLM-assisted research workflows—AgenticTuner, provenance-enforcing multi-agent pipelines, GalaxyWiki and DarkMatterFM-Registry—alongside simulation-based inference and generative surrogates: conditional normalizing flows for DESI N(z) and standard sirens, SBi3PCF, Fourier neural operators for MHD and spin fields, and macrocanonical generators. Gravitational-wave work adds unified waveform generators and LISA/ET detection pipelines. New community resources include the COSMIO and FAIR Universe weak-lensing benchmarks, Survey of Surveys DR3 (10.13 million stars), and the SWXAI explainability library.
themes: Solar, stellar and planetary ML applications
